packages.name: Piye
packages.trait_help: Ordinary Priests produce +1 Food. +25% Great General emergence within your cultural borders.

unit.name: Kushite Archer
unit.strategy: An early hill fighter with two guaranteed first strikes. Retains the Archer's city and hill defenses and both medieval upgrade paths.

building.name: Napatan Cult Chapel
building.strategy: A Monument replacement with one additional Culture and one Priest slot. Assign a Priest to receive Piye's Food bonus; an empty slot produces nothing. Retains Astronomy obsolescence.

packages.history: Piye ruled Napatan Kush in the eighth century BCE and campaigned into Egypt. His royal inscriptions emphasize Amun and the legitimacy of kingship. This package draws on Napatan religious institutions rather than the much later ironworking identity often associated with Meroe. The cult chapel is a repeatable gameplay institution, not a claim that an identical royal monument stood in every settlement.
packages.art_status: Existing primary and separate nonshader model retained. Package XML confirms the 64px Piye.dds portrait. Stock Archer and Monument art are provisional, not claimed as final Nubian costume or architecture. Full diplomacy/graphics acceptance pending.
packages.flag_note: Original geometric gold winged solar disk on purple, inspired by ancient Nile religious imagery. Modern gameplay reconstruction, not an attested national flag or an archaeological facsimile.

packages.name: Stefan Dusan
packages.trait_help: Mines produce +1 Commerce yield when worked. Ordinary Priests produce +1 Espionage.

unit.name: Vlastela Cavalry
unit.strategy: A Knight replacement with +25% hills attack and +25% against Melee units. Requires both Horse and Iron, Guilds and Horseback Riding. Pikemen remain a serious counter.

building.name: Zakonik Court
building.strategy: A Courthouse replacement with -60% maintenance in total and +2 Culture. Retains the ordinary Courthouse's +2 Espionage and Spy slot.

packages.history: Stefan Dusan ruled a fourteenth-century Serbian empire and promulgated his law code in 1349. The Vlastela represents medieval noble cavalry, while the court and mining-based economy abstract legal administration and developed mining settlements. These are not later Hajduk, Chetnik or modern cavalry formations. The Priest's Espionage represents literate institutions in the game's specialist system, not a historical claim about a spy religion.
packages.art_status: Existing package explicitly uses the primary Putin.nif in both shader fields; retained without claiming nonshader runtime certification. Package XML confirms dusan.dds portrait. Stock medieval Knight and Courthouse visuals are provisional. No later Serbian uniform imports.
packages.flag_note: Original geometric white double-headed eagle on red, inspired by medieval Serbian imperial heraldry. A simplified gameplay reconstruction, not a claim to reproduce a surviving personal standard.

packages.name: Matthias Corvinus
packages.trait_help: Melee and Gunpowder units receive Paid Professionals: 25% cheaper upgrades, retained normally on upgrading or gifting. Ordinary Artists produce +1 Research.

unit.name: Black Army Arquebusier
unit.strategy: A stronger Musketman replacement with Drill I, costing 100 Production and one additional Gold per turn in unit costs. Retains Gunpowder and the Rifleman upgrade.

building.name: Corvinian College
building.strategy: Retains Education, 200 Production and +25% Research. Adds +3 Culture and one Artist slot. Assigned Artists receive the leader trait's Research bonus.

packages.history: Matthias Corvinus ruled Hungary from 1458 to 1490. His paid forces included early handgun troops, while his court supported Renaissance learning. The college abstracts scholarly patronage rather than placing copies of the royal library in every city. The Black Army's professionalism came with real financial costs. The unit uses the game's Gunpowder tier, not later mounted Cuirassier equipment.
packages.art_status: Retained primary/nonshader geometry and costume. Missing stock Darius specular map restored with matching donor normal/environment/mask evidence. No supplied portrait button: explicitly provisional original raven-emblem button, not a portrait or an audit render. Stock Gunpowder infantry and University art are prototypes, not authenticated Black Army uniforms or a royal-library model.

repairs.evidence: Darius NRML.dds, Darius_ENV.dds and Darius_ENVMask.dds in Matthias match stock Darius byte-for-byte; both retained NIFs reference the missing stock Darius_SPEC.dds.

packages.flag_note: Original geometric raven holding a gold ring on pale gold, inspired by Corvinian heraldry. A simplified provisional emblem, not a facsimile of a historical royal banner.

packages.name: Pedro II
packages.trait_help: Ordinary Scientists produce +1 Culture; ordinary Artists produce +1 Research. +25% Great Person rate.

unit.name: Voluntarios da Patria
unit.strategy: A Rifleman replacement costing 100 Production, with March. Retains strength 14, Rifling, no resource requirement and the Infantry upgrade. No extra drafting or free unit spawning.

building.name: Imperial Lyceum
building.strategy: A University replacement with +35% Research in total, +1 Culture and one Artist slot. Retains Education and the parent's other prerequisites.

packages.history: Pedro II reigned in Brazil from 1831 to 1889 and cultivated scientific and scholarly interests. The Voluntarios da Patria represents forces raised during the 1860s war, but recruitment was not uniformly voluntary: coercion and slavery must not be erased from that history. The Lyceum represents educational institutions rather than a claim that the emperor built an identical royal college in every city.
packages.art_status: Existing aging bearded imperial portrait and bundled 64px pedro.dds retained provisionally. No conflicting Pedro I metadata found; final identity approval remains open. Unused BoundShape/Suleiman helper meshes and stored background tilt are untouched. Stock nineteenth-century Rifleman/University art is explicitly provisional.
packages.flag_note: Original simplified green field, gold lozenge and blue imperial medallion with a gold crown. Provisional Second Empire-inspired reconstruction, not a modern republican flag or a facsimile of the full imperial arms.

packages.name: Mongkut
packages.trait_help: +20 research-modifier percentage points for a technology known to at least one alive foreign Open Borders team. Does not stack per partner; excludes war, your own team and either-direction vassal relations.

unit.name: Siamese Royal Rifle
unit.strategy: A defensive Rifleman replacement with Drill I and +25% city defense, costing 120 Production. Retains strength 14, Rifling, the anti-mounted modifier and the Infantry upgrade.

building.name: Royal Observatory
building.strategy: An Observatory replacement with two Scientist slots in total and +1 Culture. Retains Astronomy, 150 Production and +25% Research. This city building is separate from the Great Scientist's mountain Research Campus.

packages.history: Mongkut, Rama IV, ruled Siam from 1851 to 1868 after a long period in the Buddhist monkhood. His scientific interests and international diplomacy inform this package's conditional research access. Later reforms under Chulalongkorn must not be retroactively assigned to him. The Royal Rifle and Observatory are gameplay abstractions, not claims that a uniform regiment or identical royal observatory existed in every Siamese city.
packages.art_status: Retained primary mesh, costume, background and bundled portrait. Missing eye material restored from the identical shared stock eyeshadow already bundled under frederick_eyeshadow.dds. No distinct nonshader model; low-graphics acceptance remains pending. Stock Rifleman and Observatory art are provisional, not authenticated Siamese uniforms or architecture.

repairs.evidence: PyFFI resolves the 24-vertex eyeshadow geometry's base texture to missing eyeshadow.dds. The already bundled frederick_eyeshadow.dds is byte-identical to stock Justinian's shared eyeshadow.dds (192 bytes), not a replacement portrait texture.

packages.flag_note: Original simplified white elephant on red, inspired by nineteenth-century Siamese flags. Provisional geometric reconstruction, not an exact drawing of a surviving royal standard.

packages.name: Simon Bolivar
packages.trait_help: New military-conquest occupation is halved, rounded up. No reduction for peaceful transfers or an already running timer. +50% Great General rate.

unit.name: Llanero
unit.strategy: A Cavalry replacement with three movement and 40% total withdrawal, costing 140 Production. Retains strength 15, Military Tradition, Rifling, Horseback Riding, Horse and the Gunship upgrade. Other units do not gain movement.

building.name: Republican Cabildo
building.strategy: A Courthouse replacement granting +2 experience to land units trained here. Retains 120 Production, Code of Laws, the parent's maintenance modifier, Espionage and Spy slot. Sea and air units receive no experience bonus.

packages.history: Simon Bolivar was a central figure in northern South American independence and the republic commonly called Gran Colombia, which existed from 1819 to 1831. Llanero cavalry served opposing sides as well as independence forces; the unit is a regional cavalry abstraction rather than a claim of uniform political loyalty. The Cabildo represents civic institutions. This package is not the modern Republic of Colombia and uses no modern Search Bloc imagery.
packages.art_status: Retained primary model, portrait content, costume and background geometry/camera. The supplied 61x61 portrait is resampled to a separate 64x64 RGBA runtime button; original retained. Runtime KFM changes only its missing donor model binding to bundled Bolivar.nif; all animation bytes retained. A reviewed background repair keeps the donor's two matching constant root controllers and verifies their composed orientation equals the retained NIF; absent sky/material targets are omitted. No distinct nonshader model. Stock nineteenth-century Cavalry and Courthouse visuals are provisional; no modern Search Bloc substitution.

repairs.evidence: Roster gate rejects the supplied non-power-of-two DDS. Preserve the original; LANCZOS-resample the same complete RGBA portrait to 64x64 and encode uncompressed DDS without cropping or substituting art.
The original KFM points at an absent donor model. Only its length-prefixed model field changes; the _alex_parent skeleton and all existing eight animation filenames/transitions remain byte-identical.

tools/prepare_bolivar_background.py (PyFFI 2.2.3) verifies pinned donor/model hashes, retains only _julius_caesar_parent and NonAccum constant transform links, excludes the two absent targets and checks composed orientation within 1e-5. Thirteen repository donor clips share the source hash. No background mesh, material, camera or head-animation change.

packages.flag_note: Original geometric yellow-blue-red independence-era tricolor abstraction. No copied arms, stars or modern state insignia; provisional identification for the 1819-1831 republic, not an exact claim for every historical flag variant.
